scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.d:rebuild: docker compose down && docker compose up --build --detach && docker compose ps && echo -n "🚀 " && date
scripts.d:rebuild:all: docker compose down && docker compose build --no-cache && docker compose up --detach --force-recreate --wait && docker compose ps && echo -n "🚀🚀 " && date
